title: GHZ, chain (5 qubits)
blurb: Entangles 5 qubits with a line of CNOTs. Neighbour-only interactions fit almost any chip, so this is the control case.

title: GHZ, star (5 qubits)
blurb: Same state, but qubit 0 talks to all four others. No heavy-hex qubit has four neighbours, so routing must insert SWAPs.

title: QFT (5 qubits)
blurb: The quantum Fourier transform: every pair of qubits interacts once, so connectivity matters a lot.

title: Grover iteration (3 qubits)
blurb: One oracle and one diffuser. Each Toffoli needs all three qubits to interact pairwise, which heavy-hex can't provide directly.

title: Random circuit (5 qubits)
blurb: Qiskit's random_circuit with depth 4 and fixed seed 1234: a mix of gate types with no structure to exploit.
